reserves.name: M token held by Nerona USDnr
reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 Protocol minters and their short-duration U.S. Treasury collateral

reserveReview.rationale: Nerona describes USDnr as fully backed by short-duration Treasuries through M0, and the configured M0 extension identifies M as the directly held wrapper asset. No primary source supports the prior separate 1% stability-reserve estimate, so the reviewed direct composition is 100% M.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live M0-extension single-asset row, Nerona wrapper design, and M0 USDnr disclosure
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The public sources do not publish current M0 minter allocation or Treasury-position weights behind the M held by the extension.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Nerona states that it does not custody client assets, while the extension holds M on-chain and M0 minters hold underlying collateral through SPVs. Current provider shares, named SPV custodians, and rehypothecation terms are not public.
